notes.title: Warplanes: WW1 Fighters – graphics update is now available
notes.notes:
We continue to improve Warplanes: WW1 Fighters, which has been a huge success thanks to a great community. 
Our goal is to improve the entire Warplanes trilogy. Each game has taught us something. We try to utilize gained experience retroactively, updating older titles and implementing features we developed more recently. We don't want any group of fans to feel left behind. We strive to ensure that fans of WW1 Fighters, Battles over Pacific and Air Corp have the best experience possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39832566/1cdbf8cb0b3c76bf877657c7d21ccb889bb5048f.png[/img]

This time, the changes mainly focus on graphics. As you have noticed the build weighs more. That's thanks to high-resolution terrain textures and new trees, so you'll be dogfighting over better-looking, more diverse terrain. Subtle tweaks in lighting should improve the overall graphics quality.

Terrain generation has been improved, making it smoother. We've improved the look of cities by replacing textures and adding new buildings.

[h3]Changelog:[/h3]
[list]
● New hi-res terrain and tree textures.
● Dynamics shadows on player planes.
● Improved lighting.
● Improved cities – new buildings and textures.
● Takeoffs and landings physics tweaks.
● Adjustment of several airplanes specs.
● Various bug fixes and improvements.
[/list]
We hope that you’ll enjoy the changes. Until next time pilots!

notes.title: Warplanes: WW1 Fighters – multiplayer update 4.3 is now live
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that the 4.3 update for Warplanes: WW1 Fighters is now available for download. We focused on the wishes of our dear community that continues to wage epic battles in multiplayer mode.
One of the most common wishes was the ability to choose maps in multiplayer mode. The host can now choose from 25 locations known from the singleplayer and co-op modes. We refreshed each map and added cities and other buildings, roads and rails. Of course, anti-aircraft artillery has been disabled so as not to affect the balance of gameplay.

You will also notice a compass in the cockpit. The design is based on historical references. The Central Powers and the Entente have their own unique models. By default, the compass case is fixed, but you can unlock its realistic rotation caused by gravity in the Settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39832566/373b21887ee819a61d9f45f5614421bb6ebcf270.png[/img]

Multiplayer now has an option present in the legacy version –  the host can set the limit of respawns. We've also added the Team Flare Mayhem mode to give you more options to play.

[h3]Full Changelog:[/h3]
[list]
[*]New mode: Team Flare Mayhem.
[*]Selectable maps in multiplayer mode.
[*]All maps have been refreshed; cities, buildings, railroads, ships, etc. have been added.
[*]The cockpit of the aircraft includes a compass. In addition, in the Settings player can unlock the movement of the entire compass.
[*]The host can set the limit of respawns in a session as in Legacy Multiplayer.
[*]In Legacy Co-Op mode, the host can set the number of players.
[*]Various bug fixes and improvements.
[/list]
We look forward to your feedback and would like to thank you for your continued support.

For now we’ll focus on Warplanes: Air Corp, and we encourage you to follow the development of this production. Of course support for Warplanes: WW1 Fighters will continue.

notes.title: Improved graphics and new Multiplayer – update 4.0 now available
notes.notes:
Update 4.0 is now available. It introduces a number of changes and fixes that revamp the game and add new functionality to the multiplayer. It is the biggest update to Warplanes: WW1 Fighters and we have been working on it for the last 3 months.

The change you will definitely notice is the graphics. We released the first version of the game in January 2020. Since then we have learned a lot. We utilized this knowledge for Warplanes: Battles over Pacific, and now we want to revamp the first installment of Warplanes as well. We improved the skies, shaders and terrain, aircraft lighting, and reflections in the water.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39832566/a08afda33233d297d68d288bba014d44de0e11af.png[/img]

The biggest changes have reached the multiplayer mode. We listened to your feedback and in order to introduce some of the desired functionality, we had to take a bold step and created standalone multiplayer.

At the moment, the game has two modes – Multiplayer launched from the main menu and Legacy Multiplayer, the core rules of which have remained unchanged, but it too has received features and new content.
[h3]Legacy Multiplayer (available, as before, from within the Campaign)[/h3]
[list]
[*] We added a second board so that you can manage your planes in an intuitive and easy way.
[*] We added a requested feature of enabling friendly fire in the Team Deathmatch, Co-Op and Raid modes.
[*] 15 new maps available for PvP modes.
[/list]
NOTE: In Legacy Multiplayer planes are shared with the Singleplayer mode.
[h3]Multiplayer (new, launched from the main menu)[/h3]
[list]
[*] All planes are available from the start and are fully upgraded.
[*] Player gains experience that unlocks more ranks. Ranks unlock new decals (over 60 new pictures!).
[*] Host can select which planes are allowed in the session. This gives you the possibility to exclude some planes or even to create a session with only one playable plane.
[*] We added a requested feature of enabling friendly fire in the Team Deathmatch, Co-Op and Raid modes.
[*] Added favorite bar in the respawn window. You can add up to 3 planes to favorites and pick a respawn plane swiftly.
[*] 15 new maps available for PvP modes are of course also present in the new Multiplayer.
[/list]
[b]Important Information[/b]
[list]
[*] Leaderboards have not been reset.
[*] The modes are compatible with each other – players from the new Multiplayer as well as Legacy Multiplayer can play with each other. The exception is for the new Multiplayer sessions with the Allowed Planes option enabled. This feature is only available in the new Multiplayer.
[*] There are no differences in game balance between modes.
[/list]
We hope that you’ll enjoy the new update. Since the update required a lot of changes, please let us know if you encounter any bugs or problems. Feel free to use our [url=https://www.homenetgames.com/support/]support form[/url] or leave a note on our [url=https://discord.gg/ntPmutN]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Update 3.0 – Two new planes and more
notes.notes:
Update 3.0 for the Warplanes: WW1 Fighters is now available. This time we are introducing several smaller improvements as well as two new planes!

[b]New wings[/b] – Pfalz D.III and Sikorsky S-16 are waiting for the best pilots out there. Be sure to check them and acquaint yourself with these two amazing machines.

[b]The Joy of Shooting[/b] – thanks to the new and improved responsiveness of the machine guns as well as their overall audiovisual layer – shooting has never been more fun. Immerse yourself as one of the Sky Aces and strike a new kind of fear into your opponents!

[b]Multiplayer improvements[/b] – as usual, the update brings some bug fixes and minor improvements. Among other things – the "vote to start" button has been eradicated from existence. Spawn points in PvP matches also got some attention and love.

Thanks for all your reviews and messages, they help us make the game better and better.

[url=https://www.facebook.com/gaming/warplanesvr]Follow us on Facebook[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/ntPmutN]join our Discord[/url] to be up to date with Warplanes updates and more.

notes.title: Update 2.4 – multiplayer improvements and fixes
notes.notes:
Dear pilots!
2.4 update brings general stability improvements for the multiplayer mode.
Warplanes: WW1 Fighters supports cross-platform multiplayer across PC (SteamVR, Oculus Rift, HTC Viveport) and Oculus Quest. Therefore providing the best experience for all devices was our top priority while working on this update.
We addressed the disconnect issue while playing long sessions and some rare bugs we caught during additional testing sessions.
See you online!

notes.title: Update 2.3 – Spectator mode
notes.notes:
Update 2.3 is dedicated mostly to multiplayer mode and it fixes some minor bugs.
[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] Spectator mode added – now after reaching the limit of respawns you are placed in other players’ planes as a spectator. Switch between players using A/B/X/Y buttons (on most controllers).
[*] Matchmaking improvements.
[*] Information about about number of players and sessions is displayed while searching for open game.
[*] Fixed bug causing wrong position of the camera after exiting multiplayer (SteamVR only)
[/list]
Don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/wXfEZHtgEh]Discord[/url] to meet new companions for multiplayer.

notes.title: Update 2.2 – Co-op Mission Editor and Quick Play mode
notes.notes:
Update 2.2 is now available. After post-release hotfixes and implementing HOTAS support we needed some time to polish and optimize the game. Update is introducing Co-op Mission Editor allowing you to create missions and raids available in the multiplayer mode. We also adjusted the interface and hopefully made the navigation through the game easier.
Finally a small feature: Quick Play mode. Press one button and a random mission, on a random plane will be launched. Perfect if you want to quickly show VR to your friend or just play one round when you have a short break.
[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] Co-op Mission Editor (beta)
[*] Quick Play mode.
[*] Settings are now available from the main menu.
[*] Controls help screen – quickly check the control scheme for your VR controller.
[*] Long press of any analog stick now resets the camera.
[*] Dead zone on analog sticks adjusted.
[*] Shaders optimization (improved performance on low-end machines).
[*] UI and UX improvements.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[/list]
[h2]Co-op Mission Editor[/h2]
When you’ll launch Warplanes WW1 Fighters on Steam (not through SteamVR Home), a pop-up window will show – select Co-op Mission Editor. It's a standard “2D” application and it doesn't support VR.
Editor is self-explanatory, you’ll be able to quickly create missions and raids (raid is created when you add more missions to the same campaign). Fully functional editor is also available in a demo version of the game.

notes.title: Update 2.1 – HOTAS and gamepads support, private lobbies in multiplayer
notes.notes:
Thank you for reporting bugs and posting your ideas. We are humbled by a warm welcome on Steam, and thankful for feedback from a new group of players.

Let’s start with a feature requested by the Steam community since the release – HOTAS and gamepads support. We are giving you a variety of customization options and hopefully you’ll be able to adjust controls to your preferences. Head to the settings to set up your device after first launch after the update. Please mind that your controller should be plugged in and turned on before launching the game. Otherwise it may not be detected.

We are utilizing Revired plug-in to provide support for various controllers. Check the [url=https://guavaman.com/projects/rewired/docs/SupportedControllers.html]Revired compatibility list[/url] if your device is supported.

HOTAS support is also available in the demo – let us know if you experience any issues or you want us to tweak something.

Second requested feature are private lobbies in multiplayer. You can create a password protected room where you can invite your friends and play PvP or Co-op together. After the match is finished, you’ll end up in the same lobby together, so you play another round or even change the mode.

If you are looking for partners for multiplayer we are inviting you to our [url=https://discord.gg/wXfEZHtgEh]Discord[/url].

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] HOTAS and gamepads support [PCVR only].
[*] Private multiplayer lobbies.
[*] Co-op gunner’s seat issue fixed.
[*] Junkers D.II stalling issue fixed.
[*] Rewards  for Co-op missions increased.
[*] Further controllers compatibility improvements (WMR) PCVR only].
[/list]
[h2]What’s next?[/h2]
We are working on a simple and intuitive mission editor that allows you to create Co-op raids and share them with the community.

Another important task is polishing the UI and enhancing UX. After those changes the game should be more intuitive and simpler to navigate on.

notes.title: Hotfix 2.0.2, controller compatibility list and HOTAS support
notes.notes:
On Friday we’ve released 2.0.1 hotfix for the most common issue with missing grip on VIVE Wands and WMR controllers. We are still getting reports that thumbsticks and some buttons on WMR controllers (ex. Lenovo Explorer) are not working properly – we’ll deal with those issues this week.

[h1]Hotfix changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*] VIVE Wands and WMR controllers – partial compatibility added.
[*] Resetting position issues fixed.
[*] Comfort mode on distant FOV adjustments.
[*] Pause during taking off bug – fixed.
[/list]

Number of devices makes testing of all configurations quite difficult – so any detailed reports are much appreciated.
We are a small studio that just entered the VR market. We don’t want to treat you as testers, we don’t want to sell you a game that doesn’t work as you expect either. That’s why we released a demo and we kindly ask for your help.

[h1]Controllers compatibility list – help needed[/h1]
This is our compatibility list. If you own hardware from a not supported list (Not tested controllers), we’d be extremely grateful if you could install the demo and report the issues and your hardware name. To make it easier, we also listed probable issues and expected behaviour for specific controllers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39832566/cd4828ae02ac37bca2ec787fbf146d00675af2d9.png[/img]

[h2]Tested controllers[/h2]
[b]No compatibility issues known:[/b]
[list]
[*] Oculus Touch (Rift, Rift S, Quest, Quest 2)
[*] Valve Index
[*] VIVE Cosmos
[*] HP Reverb G2
[/list]
[h2]Not tested controllers[/h2]
[h3]WMR controllers[/h3]
[list]
[*] Lenovo Explorer
[*] Samsung HMD Odyssey+
[*] Other WMR controllers
[/list]
Are there problems with the grip and punching machine gun handle (faster reload)?

Is moving the left thumbstick up / down causes increasing / decreasing speed of the plane (alternative controls of virtual throttle from the cockpit).

Is pressing the left thumbstick opens Steam overlay?

Is pressing the menu button opens the pause menu (settings)?

[h3]VIVE Wands (gen 1 and 2)[/h3]
Are there problems with the grip and punching machine gun handle (faster reload)?

Is pressing menu button on the left controller is causing switching plane (2 planes must be unlocked and set to “Fly to mission”, possible in the demo)

Is moving your finger up / down on the touchpad causes increasing / decreasing speed of the plane?

Is pressing the left touchpad (click) copens pause menu (settings)?

Is pressing the left system button opens Steam overlay?

[h1]HOTAS support[/h1]
After resolving those issues we plan to work on HOTAS support starting with Thrustmaster T.16000M, after your initial feedback we’ll do our best to expand the list of supported devices.

What's your expected controls with  HOTAS support? Our idea is to combine motion controllers for menu navigation, dropping bombs, using flare gun, and add HOTAS for flaps and rudder. Let us know wthat you think.

Thank you for your feedback and warm welcome on Steam!

notes.title: Warplanes: WW1 Fighters SteamVR release
notes.notes:
Today, almost two months after initial release on SideQuest, we can finally introduce the SteamVR version of Warplanes: WW1 Fighters. 

After update 2.0, all versions share the same content and cross-platform multiplayer is available. The PC version benefits from the more powerful hardware – we’ve increased textures resolution, terrain grid density and foliage density. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39832566/44700736d5b8f6fbcc253794576dc800117fec8f.png[/img]

Version 2.0 contains all updates and features, that wouldn’t be possible if not the feedback from wonderful communities on SideQuest and itch.io.  To thank you for your input, we’d like to offer you a free Steam key if you purchased the game before March 5.

Head to [url=www.homenetgames.com/keys]www.homenetgames.com/keys[/url] and follow the instructions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39832566/90d127478e3cdaa8fdc74e906bcc4ee9743b9181.png[/img]

The Oculus App Lab version is currently pending review, we don’t know if we’ll be able to provide you with a complimentary key, but we’ll do our best. If you have decided to wait for the Oculus App Lab version, then please do not take the Steam key at this time. If possible, we’ll be offering an extra key for more platforms, but at the moment, only Steam is available.

notes.title: Grab your free Steam key! PCVR release on March 4, 2021!
notes.notes:
Warplanes: WW1 Fighters is coming to PC and it will be available on Steam tomorrow!

If you previously purchased the Oculus Quest version for itch.io, then you are eligible for a free Steam key and you can get it now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39832566/4607e08e3fb1a7a1ed828b97ee17685069825e0c.png[/img]

We can offer you one complementary key. If you have decided to wait for the Oculus App Lab version, then please do not take the Steam key at this time. If possible, we’ll be offering an extra key for more platforms, but at the moment, only Steam is available.

If you own a PCVR rig, or if you want to give your Steam key to a friend, here is a super simple manual to do so:
[olist]
[*] Head to [url=https://www.homenetgames.com/keys]www.homenetgames.com/keys[/url].
[*] Enter your email used for purchase on itch.io and click “Send”.
[*] If your email is in the database, you just have to click “Send me the key”.
[/olist]
You’ll receive your key in your email, if not, please double check that it hasn’t landed in the “Spam” folder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39832566/0d6fee5a4c837262f38fa35c22d895e1a8c53204.png[/img]
[h2]What’s new in the 2.0 version?[/h2]
Simultaneously with the Steam release, the itch.io version will be updated as well. Most of the changes were related to the PC build, but we managed to fix some bugs and tweak the game as well. 
[list]
[*] Two new planes: Airco DH.4 and Albatros C.III.
[*] Sticky grip option – you don’t have to constantly press the grip button to hold the stick or throttle. This feature can be enabled in the settings.
[*] Bug fixes and tweaks.
[/list]
Join the discussion on [url=https://discord.gg/wXfEZHtgEh]Discord[/url] and follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/warplanesvr]Facebook[/url].
